card.name: End of dose-rate and dose-level phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of a dosing phrase, such as 'day' in mg/m2/day, or 'level' and 'schedule' after 'same dose' or 'dose'. It appears in dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: Per-day unit
modes.description: The 'day' or 'd' ending a per-body-size daily dose such as mg/m2/day.

modes.label: Dose level or schedule
modes.description: 'level' or 'schedule' right after 'dose' or 'ramp-up' when saying to resume or keep the dose.
modes.example: Withhold until Grade 1 or less, then maintain at same dose<< level>> or consider dose reduction.

card.plain: It marks the final word of a dose expression, like per day or dose level, in dose-adjustment text.
